identity.title: [v0.91.7][ci] Upgrade pinned Actions away from deprecated Node 20 runtime

values.task_boundary: Replace only annotated Node 20 action pins, strengthen their static contract, retain inventory, and prove hosted annotations absent.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: All checkout occurrences use reviewed checkout v7 Node 24 commit
AC2: All upload-artifact occurrences use reviewed v7 Node 24 commit
AC3: All rust-cache occurrences use reviewed v2.9.1 Node 24 commit
AC4: Deprecated SHAs are absent and immutable full-SHA policy remains enforced
AC5: A GitHub-hosted PR run emits no Node.js 20 deprecation annotation
dependencies: GitHub-hosted Actions runner and official action release metadata
